data.gender_notes: Nasikh is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who gives instructions or leads, from the Arabic root ‘n-s-kh’ meaning to lead, guide, or instruct. In Islamic history, the title 'Nasikh al-Millah' refers to a leader or ruler of the Muslim community who upholds and enforces the teachings of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Nasikh carries the meaning “Leader, Administrator” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nasikh usually hope their child will grow to embody leader, administrator and live with faith, good character and purpose.
